user.title: Smart Heating
user.description: Pick the boiler switch, where the flow temperature comes from, and the notify action for your phone. Radiators, zones and profiles start from the built-in seed and can be changed later. The integration starts in dry run: it decides and shows, but sends nothing.

abort.already_configured: Smart Heating is already set up.

set_mode.name: Set mode
set_mode.description: Auto, Manual or Off. Frost protection runs in every mode.

boost.name: Boost zone
boost.description: Raise a zone's target and/or move it up the priority list for a while.

position.name: Position
position.description: New place in the priority list (0 = top).

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Leave empty for until the profile changes.

cancel_boost.name: Cancel boost
cancel_boost.description: Cancel a zone's boost, or all boosts.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: Zone name; leave empty for all.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Cancel all boosts and fire smart_heating_resume for profile rules.
